description: Tushar Karmakar, a Sydney-based senior creative designer, motion designer and AI content creator. Campaigns, motion and AI visuals for Samsung, Oxfam, BRAC and more.

hero.title: Simplicity Brings
hero.subline: Sydney-based creative making campaigns, motion and AI-generated visuals for brands like Samsung, Oxfam and BRAC.

work.title: From brief
work.intro: Every project starts with a question, not a tool. I blend brand strategy, design craft and AI-powered production to turn a brief into visuals that move on screen, in store and in the feed.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: The brief, the audience and the one thing the work has to say. Clarity first, pixels later.

steps.title: Explore
steps.text: Moodboards, AI explorations and rough frames to find the strongest direction fast.

steps.title: Craft
steps.text: Design, motion and AI generation, refined by hand to a brand-ready finish.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Every format and channel, on time, with organised files your team can actually use.
